written.description: Runs a red-team engagement from a terminal CLI, with an orchestrator that starts specialist stacks like BloodHound or a C2 server only when the engagement reaches them.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(cli): carry engagement config through resume and answer requests (#981)

The initial submit sent engagement_name/workspace_path/target_value/
target_type/authorization_confirmed via config.configurable, but the
two resume paths (answerQuestion and the paused-resume branch of
resume()) only sent command.resume + the model-override update — no
configurable at all. A planning interview could therefore resume with
the wrong runtime workspace defaults even though its case documents
already existed, matching the validation-reports-missing-documents
symptom in #973.

Extract the configurable-building logic (previously inlined in
submit) into buildConfigurable(), and call it from all three request
sites so they agree on the same engagement context. An explicit false
authorization_confirmed still comes through as false, not omitted —
unchanged from submit's existing behavior.

Fixes #973.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
